Verified on PR #794's CI: 25 checks pass but the required Review Lab lane fails in 6 seconds at 'Run Review Lab full verification' (a passing run takes ~2 minutes), consistent with an immediate 429 on the first pull: Review Lab builds review-api from apps/api/Dockerfile whose base image comes from Docker Hub.
